About the job
Job overview:
Northstar Health builds software that helps people manage chronic conditions.

About you:
You enjoy owning ambiguous infrastructure and application-development problems end-to-end.

Your impact:
Build AI-powered tools using Claude, Amazon Bedrock, LiteLLM, and MCP tool gateways.
Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs, GitLab, and Slack chatops, and monitor systems with Datadog.

You will love this job if you:
Enjoy mentoring teammates and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders.

Requirements for this role:
8+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
Proficiency in Ruby, Python, TypeScript/Node, or Go.
Hands-on experience with a modern LLM platform.
Familiarity with AWS infrastructure and secure-by-default patterns.

Bonus points for:
Experience with LangChain and Terraform.

Benefits:
Remote-first culture
Health, dental, and vision insurance
401k retirement savings plan

Below is a summary of salary ranges for this role.
Zone 1: $179,400 - $224,300
Zone 2: $171,600 - $214,500
